items.q: Well now, he was the leader of our group.

ctx.x: Well now, he was the leader of our group. We were all kids then, you know, but he later became that. And he was a trumpeter, and we made him president of our club. And then we had another trumpet player, clarinet player, and banjo, bass drum and piano. And so we'd play for the thing.
